newsitem.title: PHILIPPINES: Seafront eyes 200-hectare lot in Mindanao.
newsitem.headline: Seafront eyes 200-hectare lot in Mindanao.

text.p: Seafront Resources Corp said on Monday it had signed a memorandum of agreement with two local firms to study the possibility of developing a 200-hectare land in the southern Mindanao island.
The agreement calls for Seafront and Benter Management and Construction Corp to determine the technical and financial feasibility of developing the land into an industrial estate.
The third company involved in the agreement is the government's Phividec Industrial Authority which owns the land in Misamis Oriental province.
If the study shows that it is feasible, the three companies will form a joint venture company to undertake the development, Seafront told the Philippine Stock Exchange.
Seafront was converted last year into a financial holding company from an oil exploration firm.
